description.raw:
'''Innate:''' '''Renekton's''' [[File:Basic attack cursor icon.png|20px|link=Basic attack|An icon representing the keyword Basic attack]] [[:Basic attack|basic attacks]] generate [[File:Fury resource.png|20px|link=Manaless#Fury|An icon representing the keyword Fury]] [[:Manaless#Fury|5 Fury]] [[File:On-hit icon.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#On_Hitting|An icon representing the keyword On-hit]] [[:Attack_effects#On_Hitting|on-hit]]. After 12 seconds of being out of combat and not basic attacking, he loses 1 Fury every 0.25 seconds.

Entering combat or using an attack will stop the Fury loss and refresh the timer. Additionally, while ''[[File:Renekton Dominus.png|20xpx|border|link=Renekton#Dominus|An icon for Renekton's ability Dominus]] [[Renekton#Dominus|Dominus]]'' is active, the timer is continuously refreshed.
description.text:
Innate: Renekton's basic attacks generate 5 Fury on-hit. After 12 seconds of being out of combat and not basic attacking, he loses 1 Fury every 0.25 seconds.
Entering combat or using an attack will stop the Fury loss and refresh the timer. Additionally, while Dominus is active, the timer is continuously refreshed.

description2.raw: While '''Renekton''' has at least 50 Fury, his next [[File:Champion ability.svg|20px|link=Champion ability|An icon representing the keyword Champion ability]] [[:Champion ability|basic ability]], excluding ''[[File:Renekton Slice and Dice.png|20xpx|border|link=Renekton#Slice and Dice|An icon for Renekton's ability Slice and Dice]] [[Renekton#Slice and Dice|Slice]]'', consumes 50 Fury to become empowered with an additional effect. Empowered abilities do not generate Fury.
description2.text: While Renekton has at least 50 Fury, his next basic ability, excluding Slice, consumes 50 Fury to become empowered with an additional effect. Empowered abilities do not generate Fury.

description3.raw: '''Renekton''' generates 50% '''bonus''' Fury from all sources while below 50% of his '''maximum''' health.
description3.text: Renekton generates 50% bonus Fury from all sources while below 50% of his maximum health.

notes.raw: * Basic attacks against any enemy that is not a structure will generate the Fury. ** '''Renekton''' can generate Fury by collecting [[File:HoneyfruitSquare.png|20xpx|border|link=Honeyfruit|An icon representing Honeyfruit]] [[Honeyfruit]] and [[Health Relic]]s (interacts with ''Reign of Anger's'' bonus generation). * PENDING FOR TEST: Fury generation with parrying effects ([[File:Blind icon.png|20px|link=Blind|An icon representing the keyword Blind]] [[:Blind|blind]], [[File:Jax Counter Strike old.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#Parrying|An icon representing the keyword Dodge]] [[:Attack_effects#Parrying|dodge]], [[File:Spirit's Refuge.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#Parrying|An icon representing the keyword Block]] [[:Attack_effects#Parrying|block]])
notes.text:
Basic attacks against any enemy that is not a structure will generate the Fury.
* Renekton can generate Fury by collecting Honeyfruit and Health Relics (interacts with Reign of Anger's bonus generation).
PENDING FOR TEST: Fury generation with parrying effects ( blind, dodge, block)
